_readme: ETF Innovators episode grid (filtered-content, preset etf-innovators).
The live insights feeds are the source: every year from settings.firstYear to the current year, kept to links matching settings.linkMatch.
This file only adds what the feed does not have, and overrides it where needed.
companies: names for the Company filter. Each is found in the episode title, then tags, then description. match is an optional pattern when the name alone will not match.
categoryRules: the eyebrow label above the title. Checked in order against tags + title, then description; first match wins.

overrides: keyed by the last part of the episode URL. Any field set here wins over the feed: title, company, category, speaker, date (e.g. May 2026), watch (e.g. 8 min), thumbnail, hidden (true hides the episode).
An override with a title and url for a slug that is not in the feed adds that episode by hand (also needs date and thumbnail).
Keys starting with an underscore are notes and are ignored.
